appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Top Regions: Ad Spend vs Sales'.
Y-axis label: 'Sales ($ thousands)'. Tick marks range from 25 to 170, with labeled increments of 10 (e.g., 60, 70, 80, ..., 170).
X-axis label: 'Advertising Spend ($ thousands)'. Tick marks range from 25 to 75, with labeled increments of 5 (e.g., 30, 35, 40, ..., 75).
Five data points, each labeled with a region identifier (Region A to Region E).
Region A is located at approximately (30, 63).
Region B is located at approximately (40, 71).
Region C is located at approximately (50, 88).
Region D is located at approximately (60, 113).

printed_facts.fact: Region E is labeled at approximately (70, 168).
All data points are solid blue circles.
The chart displays a positive correlation between advertising spend and sales.
